name: The Binding
summary: In Orgrimmar, The Binding marks young Horde warlocks' final initiation ritual. Gan'rul Bloodeye directs each petitioner to use glyphs from the Tablet of Verga in Neeru Fireblade's summoning circle.

sections.title: Subjugation of the Void
sections.body: You face your first true test of will when you summon a voidwalker. An imp is child's play by comparison. Warlocks do not make pacts with these creatures or commune with them. You pull them across dimensions by force and bind them to serve. Gan'rul Bloodeye directs you to use glyphs from the Tablet of Verga and call the voidwalker into Neeru Fireblade's ritual circle, to break it there in single combat.

sections.title: An Unending Vigil
sections.body: Defeating the voidwalker in physical and magical combat is only half the struggle. Gan'rul Bloodeye warns that a bound voidwalker never truly accepts its enslavement. Even while it guards its master in battle as a durable, shadowy bulwark, it waits for a lapse in your concentration. If your hold over your servant ever falters, it will consume the soul of the one who bound it.

faq.q: What kind of creature is being summoned?
faq.answer: You summon a voidwalker, a towering being forged of cosmic shadow and void energies. Unlike mischievous imps, voidwalkers are brutish entities ripped from the Twisting Nether and the Void. Warlocks use them chiefly to absorb devastating physical blows.

faq.q: Where does this summoning ritual take place?
faq.answer: The ritual takes place inside Neeru Fireblade's tent in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. A summoning circle inscribed on the ground focuses the dimensional energies needed to tear a voidwalker from the Nether.

faq.q: What is the Tablet of Verga used for?
faq.answer: The Tablet of Verga holds ancient, specialized glyphs used to manifest a voidwalker and tear it through the fabric of reality. You study its inscriptions to craft the Glyphs of Summoning needed to make the summoning circle.

faq.q: Why must the warlock defeat the voidwalker?
faq.answer: Warlocks control extraplanar creatures through sheer dominance. The voidwalker yields its essence and obeys commands only after you prove your mastery by defeating it in physical and magical combat.

Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior Horde warlock trainer in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He oversees the dark education of young Horde practitioners and teaches them to enslave more potent demonic entities.

faq.q: Can a bound voidwalker ever be fully trusted?
faq.answer: Never. A voidwalker may serve for years without resistance while waiting for its master to let their guard down. The bond demands constant vigilance, for the creature harbors eternal resentment toward its captor.

angles.text: As a warlock, you move from dabbling with imps to commanding frontline terrors of shadow. The rite teaches that power must be conquered and enslaved.
As an orc, you practice the dark arts in hidden corners like the Cleft of Shadow, far from Warchief Thrall's disapproving gaze and the shamanic revival.
The Horde officially turns away from the demonic corruption of the past, yet tolerates warlock magic beneath Orgrimmar as a pragmatic necessity, under watchful eyes.
